function toRequired<T>(p: Partial<T>): Required<T> {
  return p;
}
type Prefixed<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get_${K & string}`]: T[K] };
type Suffixed<T> = { [K in keyof T as `${K & string}_get`]: T[K] };
function swap<T>(p: Prefixed<T>): Suffixed<T> {
  return p;
}
type Opt<T> = { [K in keyof T]+?: T[K] };
type Plain<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
function toPlain<T>(o: Opt<T>): Plain<T> {
  return o;
}
type Renamed<T> = { [K in keyof T as K]: T[K] };
function toRenamed<T>(o: Plain<T>): Renamed<T> {
  return o;
}
function fromPartialPlain<T>(o: Partial<T>): Plain<T> {
  return o;
}
type Keys<T> = { [K in keyof T]: string };
type Some<T> = { [K in Exclude<keyof T, 'a'>]: string };
function widenKeys<T>(o: Some<T>): Keys<T> {
  return o;
}
console.log(toRequired, swap, toPlain, toRenamed, fromPartialPlain, widenKeys);
